lines.en: : Hello and welcome to the newly refurbished Amamiya family dojo!
lines.zh: : 大家好，欢迎来到重新装修过的 Amamiya 家道场！

lines.en: : And a big thank you to everyone who did not follow Sensei to the date competition!
lines.zh: : 同时非常感谢所有没有跟着 Sensei 去约会比赛的人！

lines.en: : I hope it went horribly and that he never wants to talk to either of them ever again.
lines.zh: : 我希望那场约会糟透了，让他这辈子都不想再跟她们俩说话。

lines.en: : This room is much different without the Emerald Guardian screaming about her father.
lines.zh: : 没有翡翠守卫在这儿尖叫着喊她父亲，这房间感觉大不一样。

lines.en: : I have no idea what that means!
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道那是什么意思！

lines.en: : We had our Halloween party here last year and Molly...got really drunk and let her Irish come out.
lines.zh: : 我们去年在这儿办过万圣节派对，Molly……喝得烂醉，把她爱尔兰人的一面全放出来了。

lines.en: : Last year? But haven’t you guys only been in class together for-
lines.zh: : 去年？可你们不是才同班——

lines.en: : So how is this supposed to go exactly?
lines.zh: : 那这个到底要怎么进行？

lines.en: : The lighting is interesting, but it’s not like this is particularly scary.
lines.zh: : 灯光倒是挺有意思，不过这里也没什么特别吓人的。

lines.en: : The contest hasn’t even started yet, you friggin’ nerd.
lines.zh: : 比赛都还没开始呢，你这死书呆子。

lines.en: : Maya, the way it’s going to work is that you’re going to go in through the door on the left and Tsuneyo is going to go in through the door on the right.
lines.zh: : Maya，规则是这样的：你从左边那扇门进去，Tsuneyo 从右边那扇门进去。

lines.en: : Behind each door is a personalized room meant to scare the pants off of both of you.
lines.zh: : 每扇门后面都是一个为你们量身定做的房间，专门用来把你们吓得屁滚尿流。

lines.en: : Whoever lasts the longest in there without coming out will be the winner.
lines.zh: : 谁在里面坚持得最久不出来，谁就是赢家。

lines.en: : Yeah. I wanted to do more, but I spent my entire allowance on putting up new walls.
lines.zh: : 对。我本来想弄更多的，可我把整月的零花钱都花在砌新墙上了。

lines.en: : Sooooo we’re going to have to settle for just one room this year.
lines.zh: : 所——以今年就只能将就一个房间了。

lines.en: : But that is fine! Because if your friends know anything about you, it will be a super scary room!
lines.zh: : 不过没关系！因为如果你的朋友们了解你，那它就会是个超级恐怖的房间！

lines.en: : Tsunecchi, aren’t you payin’ attention? The scary stuff hasn’t started yet.
lines.zh: : Tsunecchi，你没在听吗？吓人的东西还没开始呢。

lines.en: : You’re not secretly a scaredy cat, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会其实是个胆小鬼吧？

lines.en: : I have never heard of that breed before.
lines.zh: : 我从没听说过那个品种。

lines.en: : It means that you’re easily frightened, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 意思是说你很容易受惊，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Oh. Then no. I do not think I am that type of cat.
lines.zh: : 哦。那就不是了。我不觉得我是那种猫。

lines.en: : I am just further away from Noodles than I have ever been before.
lines.zh: : 我只是离 Noodles 比以往任何时候都远。

lines.en: : Noodles is the bird on top of our vending machine. Tsuneyo spends a lot of time with him when she’s not busy workin’ or hangin’ out with Molly.
lines.zh: : Noodles 是我们自动贩卖机顶上那只鸟。Tsuneyo 不忙工作、也不跟 Molly 混在一起的时候，就花很多时间陪他。

lines.en: : I’m sure your bird is okay, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你的鸟没事的，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : If only his father never left. Perhaps I would feel safer.
lines.zh: : 要是他父亲没有离开就好了。也许那样我会更有安全感。

lines.en: : And I'm assuming the “father” is who I think it is, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我猜那个“父亲”就是我想的那个人，对吧？

lines.en: : I shall win this competition and ask him to come home and reunite our family.
lines.zh: : 我会赢下这场比赛，然后请他回家，让我们一家团聚。

lines.en: : So, if it’s only one room, how will we know when it’s safe to come out?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然只有一个房间，我们要怎么知道什么时候可以安全出来？

lines.en: : I mean that there’s only so much you can see in one room.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，一个房间里能看到的东西就那么多。

lines.en: : Right. Unless it’s a really big room.
lines.zh: : 对。除非它是个特别大的房间。

lines.en: : I should have asked the Emerald Guardian to cast a warding spell on me.
lines.zh: : 我该让翡翠守卫在我身上施个守护咒的。

lines.en: : Beats me. I guess we’re just hoping that one of them is scary enough to force you guys out right away.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。我猜我们只是指望其中某一间足够吓人，能把你们立刻逼出来。

lines.en: : And if you find yourself looking at everything and not getting scared, just...wait until we knock, I guess?
lines.zh: : 要是你们把东西都看遍了还没被吓到，那就……等我们敲门吧，大概。

lines.en: : Feel free to come out whenever you want, Maya. One more win for the second floor girls could very well be all we need to end things.
lines.zh: : Maya，你想什么时候出来都行。二楼女生再赢一场，很可能就够我们锁定胜局了。

lines.en: : Oooooor stay inside as long as possible so we can get Sensei in our room for the beach.
lines.zh: : 或——者尽可能待久一点，这样我们就能在海边把 Sensei 弄进我们房间。

lines.en: : Yes. Stay inside even if there is someone threatening to kill you.
lines.zh: : 对。就算有人威胁要杀你，也待在里面。

lines.en: : That wouldn’t even be a test of courage anymore. It would be a test of survival.
lines.zh: : 那就不叫试胆了。那叫求生测试。
: 也就是说我们{i}要走跳板{/i}了……

lines.en: : Only if Molly put a plank in your room, Tsunecchi.
lines.zh: : 那得看 Molly 有没有在你房间里放跳板，Tsunecchi。

lines.en: : She’s the one that decorated yours, so if anything in there really does scare you, blame her and not us.
lines.zh: : 你那间是她布置的，所以里面真有什么吓到你的，怪她别怪我们。

lines.en: : And no lawsuits if you get {i}too{/i} scared!
lines.zh: : 还有，被吓{i}坏{/i}了也不许告我们！

lines.en: : By entering the scary room, you waive all of your personal freedoms and agree that you bear full responsibility for anything and everything that happens inside.
lines.zh: : 进入恐怖房间即视为你放弃全部人身自由，并同意由你自行承担里面发生的一切后果。

lines.en: : I swear, if there is actually someone in there who is going to try and kill me, I am going to be very mad.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，要是里面真有人想杀我，我会非常生气。

lines.en: : I, Tsuneyo Tojo, Noodle Evil Kendo Princess and Samurai of the Old Realm, Defender of All That is Delicious-
lines.zh: : 我，Tsuneyo Tojo，Noodle 邪道剑姬、旧域武士、一切美味的守护者——

lines.en: : Wow, Tsunecchi’s title got really long all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 哇，Tsunecchi 的头衔突然变得好长。

lines.en: : I shall destroy fear as I destroy green onions.
lines.zh: : 我要毁灭恐惧，就像我毁灭青葱一样。

lines.en: : I was the one who decorated your scary room. So, even if I got everything right and you're totally terrified, try to hold out so we can win. Okay?
lines.zh: : 你的恐怖房间是我布置的。所以，就算我全猜中了、把你吓个半死，也尽量撑住，好让我们赢。好吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Let’s just get this over with so poor Sana can calm down already.
lines.zh: : 好啊。赶紧搞完吧，好让可怜的 Sana 早点冷静下来。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m gonna go talk to her in a couple minutes. She seems really nervous.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我过几分钟就去跟她聊聊。她看起来紧张得不行。

lines.en: : Nervous? Me? Of course not. I am a warrior. A champion.
lines.zh: : 紧张？我？当然没有。我是战士。是冠军。

lines.en: Two girls in a line in a room made of lines approach a collection of lines and push them open.
lines.zh: 两个由线条组成的女孩，在一个由线条组成的房间里，走向一堆线条，把它们推开。

lines.en: Other things happen while this happens.
lines.zh: 在这期间，别的地方也在发生别的事。

lines.en: : Sana, as much as I want to win, I {i}will{/i} understand if you don’t want to follow through with this.
lines.zh: : Sana，虽然我很想赢，但如果你不想坚持到底，我{i}能{/i}理解。

lines.en: : No one in the class would want to stand up there in front of everybody for the sake of being judged.
lines.zh: : 班上没有人会愿意为了被评头论足而站到所有人面前。

lines.en: : Yeah, if you’re feelin’ nervous, none of us would hold it against ya. We care more about you bein’ happy than we care about sleepin’ in a room with our teacher.
lines.zh: : 对啊，你要是紧张，我们没人会怪你。比起能跟老师睡一间房，我们更在乎你开不开心。

lines.en: : I’d feel...really bad...backing out after...Ami and Ayane spent so much of last night making the outfit for me...
lines.zh: : 我……会觉得很过意不去……毕竟 Ami 和 Ayane 昨晚花了那么久给我做那套衣服……

lines.en: : She went home after the rap battle and...did her best...so...
lines.zh: : 她说唱比赛结束后就回家……尽了最大的努力……所以……

lines.en: : I have to...show everyone how hard she worked...
lines.zh: : 我必须……让大家看到她有多努力……
: 我只是……担心……Y……Yasu 会……反而赢了……

lines.en: : You kiddin’? That creepy girl over you?
lines.zh: : 你开玩笑吧？就那个阴森森的丫头？

lines.en: : That’s really kind of you, Sana. Following through with this for the sake of everyone else even though you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : Sana，你真的很温柔。明明自己不愿意，却为了大家坚持下来。

lines.en: : But really. If it gets to be too much...just give me a signal, okay?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。要是撑不住了……就给我个信号，好吗？

lines.en: : I’m your captain, so it’s my job to make sure you’re feeling fine at all times.
lines.zh: : 我是你的队长，所以确保你时刻状态良好是我的职责。

lines.en: : Yeah! You can count on Makoto!
: Besides, everybody knows Sensei likes ‘em tiny! And you’re the tiniest thing we’ve got!
lines.zh: : 再说，谁都知道 Sensei 喜欢小的！而你是我们这儿最小的！

lines.en: : Go Sana! Yeah! You got this!
lines.zh: : Sana 加油！没错！你可以的！

lines.en: : I can hear the sound of your blood.
lines.zh: : 我能听见你血液的声音。

lines.en: : I kinda need you over here!
lines.zh: : 我这边挺需要你过来的！

lines.en: : How long have you been hurting?
: I can see through the fibers.
: I can see what you conceal. What others can’t.
lines.zh: : 我能看见你藏起来的东西。别人看不见的东西。

lines.en: : I...have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : How long have you been hurting?...
: Why would you do that to yourself?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要那样对自己？

lines.en: : How long have you been hurting?...
: I can save you...I can take the pain away...
lines.zh: : 我能救你……我能把痛苦带走……

lines.en: : How long have you been hurting?...
: You...dare interrupt me in the middle of my evocation?
lines.zh: : 你……竟敢在我吟诵咒文的时候打断我？

lines.en: : This...transgression will not go unnoticed, you-
lines.zh: : 这……这等冒犯不会被放过，你——

lines.en: : When you’re not feeling well, you should tell someone.
lines.zh: : 不舒服的时候，你应该跟别人说。

lines.en: : But if you don’t want to, I give you full permission to come squeeze me whenever you want. No questions asked.
lines.zh: : 不过要是你不想说，我完全允许你随时过来抱我。不问任何问题。

lines.en: : Whatever it is, it’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 不管是什么，都会没事的。

lines.en: : Hang in there. You got this.
: Why are you so annoyingly nice to everybody?
lines.zh: : 你为什么对每个人都好得这么烦人？

lines.en: : I've been in this stupid room for like five minutes and I still can't-
lines.zh: : 我在这破房间里待了大概五分钟了，还是找不——

lines.en: One girl in a room in a house on a planet in a universe.
lines.zh: 宇宙中一颗星球上的一栋房子里，一个房间里，有一个女孩。

lines.en: Happy juice pours out of her eyes.
lines.zh: 快乐的汁水从她眼里涌出来。

lines.en: : Where did these pictures come from?!
lines.zh: : 这些照片是从哪儿来的？！

lines.en: Seeing is believing, which is why it must be horrible to be blind.
lines.zh: 眼见为实，所以失明一定很可怕。

lines.en: But in some cases, being blind might be better.
lines.zh: 但在某些情况下，看不见也许更好。

lines.en: For there are many different things out there that many people do not wish to see.
lines.zh: 因为世上有很多东西，是很多人并不想看见的。

lines.en: What is it that scares you most?
Tell me and I will capture it.
I will cage it for you.
lines.zh: 我会替你把它关进笼子。

lines.en: And together, we will observe how {i}it{/i} reacts when it is forced to come to terms with what {i}it{/i} fears most.
lines.zh: 然后我们一起观察，当{i}它{/i}被迫直面{i}自己{/i}最恐惧的东西时，会作何反应。

lines.en: A normal [teenage]girl continues to explore her cage.
lines.zh: 一个普通的[teenage]女孩继续探索她的笼子。

lines.en: It reminds her of better days.
lines.zh: 这让她想起更好的日子。

lines.en: : Kv fvb aopur zol jhu zll bz? (Do you think she can see us?)
lines.zh: : Kv fvb aopur zol jhu zll bz?（你觉得她能看见我们吗？）

lines.en: : Kvlz pa thaaly lpaoly dhf? (Does it matter either way?)
lines.zh: : Kvlz pa thaaly lpaoly dhf?（不管怎样有区别吗？）

lines.en: : Aol zllk ohz illu wshualk. (The seed has been planted.)
lines.zh: : Aol zllk ohz illu wshualk.（种子已经种下了。）

lines.en: : Zol iljvtlz jvtwshjlua pu aol jfjsl. (She becomes complacent in the cycle.)
lines.zh: : Zol iljvtlz jvtwshjlua pu aol jfjsl. (她在这个循环里变得自满了。)

lines.en: : Aoha pz uva mvy bz av kljpkl. (That is not for us to decide.)
lines.zh: : Aoha pz uva mvy bz av kljpkl.（那不该由我们决定。）

lines.en: : Fvb'yl ypnoa. Dl hyl aol dhajolyz. (You're right. We are the watchers.)
lines.zh: : Fvb'yl ypnoa. Dl hyl aol dhajolyz.（你说得对。我们是观察者。）

lines.en: : Sla bz dhajo oly iylhr avnlaoly. (Let us watch her break together.)
lines.zh: : Sla bz dhajo oly iylhr avnlaoly.（让我们一起看她崩溃吧。）

lines.en: : Aol ulea zspkl pz tf mhcvypal. (The next slide is my favorite.)
lines.zh: : Aol ulea zspkl pz tf mhcvypal.（下一张幻灯片是我最喜欢的。）

lines.en: : H zova myvt ilaaly khfz. (A shot from better days.)
lines.zh: : H zova myvt ilaaly khfz.（来自美好时光的一张照片。）

lines.en: //////////////////////////WOULD YOU LIKE TO PROCEED WITH FACTORY RESET?
: No no no no no no no no no.
: Ho, ovd dvuklymbs pa pz av il fvbun. (Ah, how wonderful it is to be young.)
lines.zh: : Ho, ovd dvuklymbs pa pz av il fvbun. (啊，年轻真好。)

lines.en: : Zol'z wylaaply dolu zol pz pu aol johpy. (She's prettier when she is in the chair.)
lines.zh: : Zol'z wylaaply dolu zol pz pu aol johpy. (她坐在那把椅子上时更好看。)
: Fvb'yl zbjo h wlyc.（你真是个变态。）

lines.en: : No no no no no no no no no no...
lines.zh: : 不不不不不不不不不不……

lines.en: //////////////////////////AS A ONE TIME COURTESY, WOULD YOU LIKE TO SEND A FINAL MESSAGE TO A CONTACT OF YOUR CHOICE?
lines.zh: //////////////////////////作为一次性优待，您是否想给一位您选择的联系人发送最后一条消息？

lines.en: //////////////////////////WHAT IS IT YOU WOULD LIKE TO SEND TO “Sensei?”
: Oh, you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
: Even in the end, I can't catch a break.
lines.zh: : 到最后我都捞不着一点好。

lines.en: //////////////////////////YOU HAVE COMPLETED THE TEST OF COURAGE
//////////////////////////PLEASE FILL OUT A SURVEY IF YOU ENJOYED YOUR TIME IN THE SCARY ROOM
lines.zh: //////////////////////////如果您在恐怖房间里玩得开心，请填写一份问卷

lines.en: : It was really hard thinking of stuff that might actually get to you since you never seem scared, so I kinda just threw a bunch of normal scary movie stuff in there in hopes that something would work.
lines.zh: : 你看起来从来都不害怕，所以想出真正能吓到你的东西真的很难，我就干脆塞了一堆普通恐怖片里的玩意儿进去，希望总有一个能奏效。
: 普通……恐怖片里的玩意儿？

lines.en: : Yeah! You know, like...vampires and ghosts and a few of those jumpscare Halloween decorations Ayane had laying around.
lines.zh: : 对啊！就是……吸血鬼啊幽灵啊，还有几个 Ayane 家里闲置的万圣节惊吓道具。

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you got so scared that you didn’t even get to see all of it?
lines.zh: : 你该不会吓得连那些都没看到吧？

lines.en: : Well, Tsuneyo only lasted like 30 seconds anyway, so you pretty much demolished her.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，Tsuneyo 只撑了大概 30 秒，所以你基本上是碾压她了。

lines.en: : Molly set a trap thingy that knocked a bowl of ramen off of a shelf if Tsuneyo pushed a button and...well, you can probably guess how that ended.
lines.zh: : Molly 设了个机关，Tsuneyo 一按按钮就会把架子上一碗拉面打翻，然后……嗯，后面的你大概猜得到。

lines.en: : Uhh...so, anyway, we’re going to start heading over to Sana’s mom’s bar thing for the fashion show. But I kind of wanted to stop at a convenience store first and-
lines.zh: : 呃……总之，我们要出发去 Sana 妈妈的酒吧办时装秀了。不过我有点想先去趟便利店，然后——

lines.en: : I’m going to go back to the dorm, actually.
: I know you’re probably still scared but...it seems like it might be a little worse than that...
lines.zh: : 我知道你可能还在害怕，不过……看起来好像比那更糟一点……
